{{Quote|This is Captain Vaclen Tor on the frigate Intruder. We are taking heavy fire and have sustained major damage. Cannot continue the fight&hellip;|Captain Vaclen Tor|<ref name="Legacy—War 4">[[Legacy — War 4|''Legacy — War'' 4]]</ref>}}
The '''''Intruder''''' was an [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigate]] that served in the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. By [[138 ABY]], the ship was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vaclen Tor]] and participated in the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|attack]] against the [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] on [[Taivas]]. During the battle, the ''Intruder'' was overwhelmed by the allied fleets of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the [[Empire-in-exile]] and destroyed.
